name: Enochian Scryer — Ryo Lu lens design evaluation
attribution: A project-specific rubric inspired by the supplied card; not an official Ryo Lu rubric or endorsement.

criteria.title: First launch and empty states
criteria.acceptance: Identify both apps, start the first task and understand an empty queue.

levels.4: Clear actions and useful empty states
levels.5: Entry, empty/loading and repeat launch verified

criteria.title: Open local media
criteria.acceptance: Open single/multiple files, spaces in names, append/drop and invalid media.

levels.5: Open, enqueue/drop, identity and invalid-file recovery verified

criteria.title: Open streams and URLs
criteria.acceptance: Play valid media URLs and recover from invalid or unreachable addresses.

levels.5: URL playback, range/seek, loading and failure recovery verified

criteria.title: Playback transport and agency
criteria.acceptance: Play/pause/resume/stop/previous/next act predictably with truthful state.

levels.5: Actions, empty-queue boundaries and visible state verified

criteria.title: Time, seeking and continuity
criteria.acceptance: Time/duration/seek agree; boundary seeks do not strand playback.

levels.5: Seek, pause/seek/resume and start/end boundaries verified

criteria.title: Audio and media adjustments
criteria.acceptance: Volume/mute and available track/speed/subtitle controls are discoverable and reversible.

levels.5: Reversible adjustments, readbacks and absent-track cases verified

criteria.title: Viewing and window modes
criteria.acceptance: Fullscreen/exit and normal/compact layouts retain reachable controls and fitted video.

levels.5: Transitions, playback continuity and visible bounds verified

criteria.title: Create a playlist
criteria.acceptance: Add multiple items, inspect names and start the intended item without losing the queue.

levels.5: Create/add/select/append and duplicate-name cases verified

criteria.title: Edit and navigate playlists
criteria.acceptance: Remove/reorder/navigate with clear selection and current item.

levels.5: Edits, navigation and empty/boundary cases verified

criteria.title: Save and reopen playlists
criteria.acceptance: Named playlist round-trip preserves order and identity; missing files have recovery.

levels.5: Named round-trip, spaces/Unicode and missing-file recovery verified

criteria.title: Add torrents and links
criteria.acceptance: Import file/link, inspect inclusion/destination, cancel and recover from invalid input.

levels.5: Both paths, invalid input, destination and cancel verified

criteria.title: Control transfers and selected files
criteria.acceptance: Pause/resume/inclusion/limits/removal affect the intended record.

levels.5: Pause/resume/inclusion/limits/removal verified against real state

criteria.title: Torrent-to-player handoff
criteria.acceptance: Completed/per-file actions select the right media/player; incomplete double-click does not launch.

levels.5: Completed/partial/per-file handoff and finish/state preservation verified

criteria.title: Show files and destinations
criteria.acceptance: Reveal the correct item; missing files and custom destinations have clear outcomes.

levels.5: Reveal, fallback, missing/custom paths and feedback verified

criteria.title: Progress and status truth
criteria.acceptance: Percentages, pieces and pending/success/error signals agree with actual state.

levels.5: Relevant states and zero/invalid counters verified; no misleading success

criteria.title: Settings and progressive disclosure
criteria.acceptance: Common preferences are simple; advanced paths remain; save/cancel/reopen are predictable.

levels.5: Save/cancel/reopen/error and preference persistence verified

criteria.title: Keyboard, focus and labels
criteria.acceptance: Core tasks have keyboard routes, visible focus, labels and usable targets without traps.

levels.5: Core journeys and modal/menu focus restoration verified; native input limits stated

criteria.title: Errors, cancellation and destructive safety
criteria.acceptance: Explain next steps; cancel commits nothing; destructive choices reset before reuse.

levels.5: Failure/retry/cancel/backdrop/Escape and destructive-state reset verified

criteria.title: Enochian fidelity and hierarchy
criteria.acceptance: Original elements match functions; both finishes are legible without clipping/material drift.

levels.5: Reference plus real-view sizing, contrast, focus and overflow checks pass

criteria.title: Install, defaults and continuity
criteria.acceptance: Install/update/default/restart/background behavior preserve records with a recovery route.

levels.5: Upgrade/restart/default/background/failure recovery verified in isolation

rules: Score each of 20 criteria with integer 1–5; sum is out of 100.
Freeze anchors/weights before the loop. Do not omit difficult journeys or award points for test count alone.
Every score needs a reason and evidence/method. Unverified requirements remain gaps, not assumed passes.
Report observed UI separately from API/source/mock/format checks. Backend-only evidence cannot establish excellent interaction quality.
Pass requires >=95 total, every criterion >=4, mandatory journeys passed and no unresolved critical/high defect.
Self-evaluation is not independent expert review. Preserve unsuccessful runs and remaining limits.
Repeat: evaluate → identify gaps → bounded fixes → build/test → drive relevant journeys → rescore unchanged rubric. Stop at the gate or a concrete validation blocker.
